wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Two rows, 250.00 + 2,000.00 = 2,250.00 = Form A's printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS 2,250.00 = the cover's THIS REPORT cell. It is NOT the CUMULATIVE cell (11,669.00) and not the LAST cell (9,419.00), so the scope test fires unambiguously: this schedule is PER-PERIOD, a DIFFERENT scope from the cumulative figure this module publishes. The 9,419.00 of prior contributions was itemized on earlier filings not present in this PDF. NOTE: this newest cover variant has NO '$50.00 or less aggregate' line at all (only three money lines), so cover_le50_* are null - the field does not exist, which is not a zero.

expenditures.detail: Form B carries no transactions: the first data row holds the single word 'None' in the 'Person or Organization Paid' column and an accounting dash in the amount cell, and the printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES cell is likewise an accounting dash. 'None' is a filer annotation, not a transaction, so it was NOT transcribed as a row (zero rows, side transcribed). The empty schedule matches the cover's THIS REPORT expense cell, which is the same accounting dash; the CUMULATIVE cell is 1,286.00, again showing this schedule is per-period. Anchors are kept verbatim as '-' rather than 0 per the bare-dash rule; in this machine-generated Excel-style form the dash is the spreadsheet's zero format, which is why the balance chain closes treating it as 0.

gates.page_subtotal: p2 rows 250.00 + 2,000.00 = 2,250.00 = printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS 2,250.00 (gate fires). p3 zero rows against a printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES of an accounting dash - consistent, nothing to sum.

gates.geometry_proof: p2: 600 dpi crop of the amount column across bands 1-3 renders '$ 250.00' (band 1), '$ 2,000.00' (band 2) and an EMPTY band 3 - first row, last row and the one-pitch-below control all as expected, so no row-index shift. Column x taken from rowbands v_rules (66.21% to 83.06%).
gates.balance_chain: Closes exactly on both columns. THIS column: 8,133.00 (balance last) + 2,250.00 contributions - 0 expenses = 10,383.00 = cover cumulative balance. CUMULATIVE column: 11,669.00 contributions - 1,286.00 expenses = 10,383.00 = cover line 4 cumulative 10,383.00. No second filing by this filer is in my chunk, so the cross-filing cumulative chain could not be run; the cover's own LAST-column figures (9,419.00 / 1,286.00 / 8,133.00) are internally consistent with it (9,419.00 - 1,286.00 = 8,133.00).

escalation_note: 600 dpi crops of the p2 amount column (bands 1-3, doubling as the geometry proof) and of the p2 date/name/address columns; both render identically to the full-page read.
